title: The passive with ser: what was built and deciphered

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know the passive with *ser* + past participle from B1 Unit 18: *Tikal fue abandonada*. The thing that receives the action is the subject, and the participle agrees with it in gender and number. History books use this form a lot.

items.spanish: Las ciudades mayas fueron construidas en medio de la selva.
items.english: The Maya cities were built in the middle of the rainforest.

items.spanish: Los glifos fueron descifrados en el siglo XX.
items.english: The glyphs were deciphered in the twentieth century.

items.spanish: Tikal fue abandonada poco a poco.
items.english: Tikal was abandoned little by little.

items.spanish: Los reyes eran enterrados en los templos.
items.english: The kings were buried in the temples.

sections.content: The participle agrees with the subject: *fue abandonada*, *fueron abandonadas*, *fueron descifrados*. If you name who did it, use *por*: *los glifos fueron descifrados por los especialistas*. The verb *ser* shows the tense: *fue* for a single event, *era* for something repeated.
